decisions.reason: As a new automation product closely aligned with the firm's integrated precast systems strategy, in a growing industry and without any visible sign of underperformance, it is likely to stay on the market while the firm learns about demand.

The firm is likely to keep this product because it fits its established robotics and plant-automation offer, though its overlap with broader shuttering solutions makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible if demand proves weaker than hoped.
This product supports the firm's full-line automation proposition and the firm appears to have enough R&D capability and product breadth to carry a still-uncertain niche offering for longer.

Management would probably retain it because it builds on core capabilities and customer needs in automated precast production, but functional similarity with other shuttering robots raises the chance of later portfolio consolidation.
